Step 1: Calculate the number of bread rolls Mrs. Sherman had after feeding her children.
Mrs. Sherman had 12 bread rolls initially. She fed her 6 children with one each, so she had 12 - 6 = 6 bread rolls left.

Step 2: Calculate the number of pieces of bread rolls she fed to the chickens.
Mrs. Sherman broke each of the remaining 6 bread rolls into 8 pieces. So, she fed 6 * 8 = 48 pieces of bread rolls to the chickens.

Answer: Mrs. Sherman fed 48 pieces of bread rolls to the chickens.
